decision: Set Godot 4.7 as the minimum and sole current terrain qualification target, retain older engine results only as history, and require explicit qualification before promoting a newer Godot version.
evidence: world-transvoxel-terrain commit 5a96a2b86c2e8dbadb0203c8a063eb3eb52e405d defaults all active addon smoke harnesses to Godot 4.7
TQP-52 and TQP-53 each pass their static contract and focused runtime smoke once on Godot 4.7
world-transvoxel-integration-game commit 177f2a3d95a523f7da1c46cfb1d3657473155c4d passes the package contract import and migration runtime smoke once on Godot 4.7
the production addon tree and exact candidate and authority package digests remain unchanged
qualified_scope: Godot 4.7 Windows x86-64 Forward+ D3D12 terrain qualification target
single-engine TQP-52 TQP-53 and TQP-54 retained evidence
explicit fail-closed admission of future Godot versions
unqualified_scope: automatic qualification of versions newer than Godot 4.7
standards_changed: TQP-52 through TQP-54 required engine matrices
review: The prior Godot 4.6.3 runs remain immutable historical observations but are no longer rerun, counted, or required. Godot 4.7 is tested once per qualification path; a newer engine replaces or expands the matrix only through a recorded qualification decision.
downstream_impact: TQP-55 and all later CPU terrain qualification must use Godot 4.7 unless a newer version is explicitly admitted. No future milestone should spend time preserving Godot 4.6 behavior.
